The '''Cignet system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Bheriz sector/Legends|Bheriz sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Droxu]].
